create_IW_SSIM_instance: create an IW_SSIM object with configurable scales, block sizes, and CUDA support for image quality assessment
test_IW_SSIM_score: test two images with IW_SSIM to compute the information-weighted multi-scale structural similarity score
build_Gaussian_filter: build a Gaussian 2D filter kernel using fspecial with a specified window size and sigma
compute_Laplacian_pyramid: compute Laplacian pyramids for two images and return multi-scale tensor representations for comparison
calculate_info_content_weight: calculate the information content weight map using SVD-based mutual information estimation across pyramid scales
